_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every numeric constant the public methodology cites. GENERATED by pipeline/emit_model_spec.py from config + code — do NOT hand-edit. To change a number, change it at its source_file/source_line (or config_key) and re-run the emit step.
_schema: each entry = { value, display, source_file, (source_line | config_key), short_label }

NORM.short_label: P1 national normalization = 100 / 0.28 (calibrates PA's 0.28 competitive counties to ~100)

min_margin.short_label: Floor on |vote margin| (pp) so a near-zero margin can't blow up 1/|margin|

default_tip.short_label: Default presidential state-tipping weight when a state is absent (the locked 0.005 floor)

p1_high.short_label: National Electoral-Leverage 'high' gate (Tier-1 capital pathway treats a county as decisive at p1_national ≥ this)

plateau_edge.short_label: State competitiveness: full weight for |seat margin| ≤ this (toss-up plateau, pp)

zero_edge.short_label: State competitiveness: weight fades linearly to 0 at |seat margin| = this (lean edge, pp)

p1_high_state.short_label: State Electoral-Leverage 'high' gate (DIFFERENT scale than national; the state-lens selectivity knob)

capital_divisor.short_label: SLS-Capital normalization divisor. B1: SLS now weights each sector by the full composite SVS; divisor recalibrated to 750000 so LA County's raw sum still anchors at ~84 on 0–100.

community_share_mult.short_label: SLS-Community share→0–100 multiplier. B1: LIFTED FROM HARDCODE (was the ×4 literal) to config and recalibrated to 1.875 for the full-composite-SVS scale (post-ramp max ~57).

sls_community_high_boundary.short_label: SLS-Community 'high' boundary on the post-ramp (Option D) scale

p2_hostile_ceiling.short_label: Incumbent Alignment: P2 < this = hostile incumbent (Transform)

p2_aligned_floor.short_label: Incumbent Alignment: P2 ≥ this = aligned incumbent (Activate)

state_tipping_swing_floor.short_label: Community Tier-1 national gate: state_tipping_weight ≥ this = swing state

state_tipping_lean_floor.short_label: Community Tier-2 national band floor: lean state
